items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: John Rowell, I mean, at Sunrise, you know. It was just, say the name who was going to play for it, so people would know.

ctx.x: Well, whoever is going to play, I said, where are you going? I'm going to play for Mr. Soil.

Yeah. Felice, come on, Felice, Felice was in Buress, I mean, that's, you know, that was going to play for him. John Rowell, I mean, at Sunrise, you know. It was just, say the name who was going to play for it, so people would know.
What sort of music did they like down there? Was it regular Dixieland type or whatever you want to call it?
